role: State Clearinghouse Coordinator, Missouri Department of Community Affairs
summary: Terry L. Rehma, as Missouri's State Clearinghouse Coordinator, reported that the pre-application for the ORV implementation project was reviewed in accordance with OMB Circular A-95 and NEPA, and that no negative comments were received from state agencies. The project was found to be not in conflict with the goals, objectives, or environmental standards of the various state agencies, and further review by the State Clearinghouse was deemed unnecessary. The letter is essentially a formal clearance notice indicating state-level approval of the project.

statement.text:
STATE OF MISSOURI
DEPARTMENT OF COMMUNITY AFFAIRS
WARREN E. HEARNES
GOVERNOR
July 13, 1972
Mr. G. Douglas Hofe, Jr., Director United States Dept. of the Interior Bureau of Outdoor Recreation Washington, D. C. 20240
RE: Implementation of Executive Order 11644 which pertains to use of Off-Road Vehicles on Public Lands.

DOCA 72060024
Dear Mr. Hofe:
The pre-application for the above project has been received and reviewed by the State Clearing-house in accordance with Office of Management and Budget Circular A-95 (Revised) and Section 102(2)(c) of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969. There were no negative comments in regard to said project.
This project is not in conflict with the goals, objectives or environmental standards of the various state agencies reviewing the application and further review is not required by the State Clearinghouse. However, this project may be subject to further review by the Regional Clearinghouse if conflicts exist on the regional level.
A copy of this letter must be attached to the Federal Funding Agency's application as evidence that you have complied with the requirements of the State Clearinghouse's project notification and review system.
49
Terry L. Rehma
State Clearinghouse
Coordinator
